confirmed_findings.observed: Optional general/evaluation/results/parameters from config A survived loading config B without them.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Config.reset clears annotated runtime sections and reset state; new singleton construction honors the same lifecycle.

confirmed_findings.observed: Dirichlet num_samples redrew variable counts and consumed randomness; reported count could disagree with actual loader.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Realize count once with private seeded RNG; repeated reads preserve weights and private/global RNG. Seeded reconstructed membership matches actual DataLoader.

confirmed_findings.observed: Original IID loop never expanded an empty source and exceeded a five-second subprocess deadline on both interpreters.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Reject empty IID input with useful ValueError; keep fixed nonempty shuffle/padding/partition membership.

confirmed_findings.observed: All 11 registered sampler constructors and speed simulation changed caller RNG state.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Use private RandomState generators without changing default legacy seeded references.

confirmed_findings.observed: Full-class label partitions used inconsistent IDs; no-anchor paths failed; excluded-anchor pool selected label 1 instead of only {2,3}; infeasible class pools hung.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Consistent zero-based partition slots, allowed-pool selection, useful bounded infeasibility errors.

confirmed_findings.observed: Sample-quantity get_sampled_data_condition treated datasource.targets method as labels.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Use actual training/testing target sequence for sampled labels.

confirmed_findings.observed: Out-of-range partition client IDs returned wrong data or failed later; orthogonal no-replacement sampling exceeded eligible class membership and selected zero-weight wrong-class samples.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Validate partition IDs and requested size against positive-weight eligibility. R2A-01 correction preserves assigned cross-silo full-pool evaluation IDs while rejecting invalid ordinary/training roles.

confirmed_findings.observed: Empty padding and infeasible Dirichlet minima hung; zero minimum raised UnboundLocalError; one-modality fallback raised invalid randint bounds.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Bound invalid empty/minimum/concentration/pool input; permit zero minimum, full-dataset single partition and single-modality fallback.
confirmed_findings.implementation_regression_caught: Overstrict minimum validation initially rejected the valid singleton/full-dataset case. red-single-partition-3.13.log captured it; corrected before final commit.

confirmed_findings.observed: Active raw TAR/ZIP extraction violated containment or silently accepted unsafe paths; preexisting destination symlinks wrote outside on both versions and marked completion.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Shared whole-manifest TAR/ZIP preflight and explicit TAR data filter, consistent on 3.13/3.14. Safe internal TAR links work; escaping names/links, symlink parents/chains, ZIP symlinks and devices reject.

confirmed_findings.observed: Exclusive-create download lock survived owner death and permanently stalled the next downloader.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Stable POSIX flock inode releases on process exit or exceptions, stays mutually exclusive with a live owner, and intentionally remains as an inert lock file.

confirmed_findings.observed: Archive/sentinel/gzip/tmp/lock symlinks could write outside; HTTP error responses were not closed; interrupted streams left partial data; unsupported extensions exited successfully.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Reject artifact symlinks, close each response, retry bounded streaming failures with partial cleanup and propagate useful unsupported-format errors.

confirmed_findings.observed: Purchase/Texas checked deleted raw files instead of NPZ readiness, redownloaded usable caches/raw data, mutated global RNG and reported hardcoded counts/failed empty test tensor shapes.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Cache-aware serialized download/preprocessing, local legacy shuffle, vectorized empty-safe tensors and actual split lengths. R2A-02 correction additionally guards all cache readers, validates complete arrays, atomically publishes successful writes and recovers legacy partial final caches.

confirmed_findings.observed: CINIC treated an empty root as downloaded; official Tiny ImageNet nested/native layout failed or classified unlabeled test/images as one class; both used hardcoded counts.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Check concrete split readiness, use labeled Tiny validation annotations and training class IDs, preserve prepared labeled layouts and report actual lengths. R2A-03/R2A-04 and root corrections enforce labeled prepared compatibility, shared training IDs, deterministic Tiny evaluation and stale-marker recovery.

confirmed_findings.observed: FashionMNIST registry alias after configured MNIST loaded MNIST labels [0,1,2] instead of [7,8,9].
confirmed_findings.resolution: Explicit alias/constructor dataset_name takes precedence over config dataset_name.

confirmed_findings.observed: EMNIST split denotes its variant; inherited train=True caused evaluation to load train labels [0,1,2] instead of test labels [7,8] for balanced and digits.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Dataset defaults explicitly set train=True and test train=False while preserving variant and user per-split kwargs overrides.

confirmed_findings.observed: Executed REFER image filter raised TypeError on nested-list indexing; annotation reference filter returned [11,22] instead of [11]. self.data was an actual dict, so the separate typing observation alone was not a runtime defect.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Accepted internal-only closure permits historical archival; original code and known limitations retained without API modernization.
